messages:
Lucas: heads up — noticed a new class of chart stalls on /dash after the routing policy rollout a few hrs ago. CPU spikes on main thread when switching time ranges :eyes:
Maya: seen it too on canary. quick repro: open dashboard -> click 30d -> freeze ~700–900ms, repeating on 4/5 runs
Aj: can you paste the perf flame? or the devtools snapshot?
Lucas: pasting a trimmed stack from profiler: `main -> chart-render -> parseTimeseries -> normalizeSeries -> memoizedSeries.get` looks like memo cache misses + huge diffing
Sarah: interesting — we changed route->cache affinity assignment in the rollout. could be changing which bundle variants get loaded, causing full re-eval instead of incremental render
Dena: I pulled a HAR and the bundle payloads look normal, but network timings show repeated fetches for intl chunk after switching range, which re-triggers a full hydrate
Lucas: minimal repro: https://canary.redwood.internal/d/abc123 (requires org admin) — note console logs: `kvcache: miss for series-agg:range=30d` repeated
Aj: quick hypothesis: routing policy changed user->region binding so prefix cache keys include region tag. older cached entries don't match -> cache miss storm when toggling ranges
Maya: that matches telemetry: charts_prefix_cache_miss spiked from ~2% -> 38% at rollout timestamp. I have a query: `select count(*) by reason from telemetry where name='charts_prefix_cache_miss' and ts > 3311109000`
Sarah: rollback window? eng-deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-20T15:02 initiated by canary.rollout-service (id: canary-rl-011). Status: successful.
Dena: temporary mitigation: we can relax the cache-key schema to ignore region tag for series-agg keys so older entries still match. but that might harm cross-region correctness
Aj: alternative: add compatibility layer in router that maps legacy cache keys -> new keys for the first 24h after rollout
Maya: I can whip a small patch to map legacy keys on read path, test on canary now.
Lucas: sounds good. also let's add a quick dashboard panel for prefix_cache_miss by model/route so we can watch rollback impact.
Sarah: can we avoid full rollback? traffic is mostly healthy, but console UX is degraded for heavy analytics pages. If fix lands in next 60–90m we can keep rolling.
Aj: local patch diff: ```diff
- key = `${region}:${tenant}:${metric}`
+ key = `${tenant}:${metric}` // drop region for compatibility
```
Dena: runbook note: if we still see steady 20%+ miss after patch, escalate to rollback.
Maya: deploying patch to canary now. eng-deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy of patch pr/4823 -> canary cluster.
Lucas: thanks — will monitor charts and run the telemetry query regularly. :thumbsup:
Maya: deployed to canary, observing initial drop in misses from 38% -> 6% on first 5m sample. will promote if stable for 30m.
Aj: opened a tiny follow-up issue to formalize cache-key migration patterns so we don't hit this again. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/879
Sarah: perfect. post-mortem should capture rollout testing gap for key schema changes.
Lucas: good call. after promote we'll add an eval that toggles common time ranges to the canary test matrix.
Maya: noted. thanks all.
